notes.title: ver 0.00.022 Major Update.
notes.notes:
Major Update."Bots" and "Auras" Have Been Added.  There are also various other fixes.

Bots are opponents that move and fight automatically. From now on, you will be able to battle against a large number of opponents at any time.
Auras are a sign of strength, recognizable at a single glance. Players will obtain one aura for each time they reach the top of the weekly rankings. Auras will float and glow around the player’s character.
It includes various fixes such as improving operability, balancing abilities and weapons, and fixing bugs. 

* Actions can now be executed by long-pressing and releasing menu icons.
* On the online match screen, when another player creates a room, a sound will now play and an announcement will be displayed.
* Sword sharpness reduction is now 2 points.
* There are some fixes to PP consumption and ability durations.

notes.title: "PSI Masquerade" Closed Beta Test
notes.notes:
The closed beta test will be available from Monday, June 20, 8:00 am PDT until Sunday, July 3, 7:59 am PDT.
If you are interested in participating in the closed beta test, clicking on the button called “Request Access” located under the “Join the PSI Masquerade Playtest” section.The closed beta test will be limited to 500 players for both the Google Play and Steam versions.
Please note that you will be able to download the closed beta test early, however, you will not be able to log in until the start date.
Closed beta test account data is only available in the closed beta version. 
Paid items will not be available for purchase during the closed beta test.
For closed beta testing on the google play store, please contact us at the email address below.
support@mururunsoft.net
